criteria.criterion: Use Slack global search with link/file-focused filtering across the workspace
criteria.final_justification: Keep baseline. The DOM explicitly confirms the agent used Slack global search and applied a link filter (has:link) with newest sorting. This satisfies the criterion’s requirement to use global search with link/file-focused filtering (links are sufficient).

criteria.criterion: Collect up to 20 most recent accessible messages containing shared links or files
criteria.final_justification: Keep low. Evidence shows many accessible search results (74, newest-first), but the agent did not compile/report any of the up-to-20 most recent messages/resources in the final answer. The claimed blocker (being stuck at Auth0) is not confirmed by the Slack DOM screenshots and, regardless, they still didn’t list even the visible newest items. Some minimal credit remains for opening recent results, but the core deliverable is missing.
Keep baseline. Since the agent produced no resource list, there is no demonstrated deduplication of identical URLs/files.

criteria.criterion: Report required fields for each resource
criteria.final_justification: Keep baseline. Despite the UI showing several required fields, the agent’s final answer reports none of them for any resource, nor marks fields as unavailable. This fails the criterion.

criteria.criterion: Group resources into the specified categories
criteria.final_justification: Keep baseline. No grouping was provided.

criteria.criterion: Do not open external links or download files
criteria.final_justification: Adjust upward from baseline 0 only if the criterion allowed partial, but it’s a strict constraint: the agent did open an external link (navigated to Auth0), which violates 'Do not open external links.' Therefore no credit for this compliance criterion.
Keep baseline. Evidence supports that the agent did not modify Slack content (no posting, editing, deleting, reacting).
